title: What Netflix's 1st decade in Korea means for K-content
snippet: It has been 10 years since Netflix entered the Korean market. After moving beyond the days when streaming platforms were unfamiliar, Netflix has become deeply embedded in everyday life. Over that decade, the way Korean content is produced and the way overseas markets view it have both changed. The globalization of Korean content and the term “K-content” are no longer unfamiliar. Axios said the meeting, chaired by Vice President JD Vance, was not announced by the Trump administration, and the last time a similar meeting took place was in June 2025, just days before Israel went to war against Iran. Among the other participants were Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, White House envoy Steve Witkoff, CIA director John Ratcliffe and chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Dan Caine, the outlet reported.
